title: Sum of Array
description: Given a space-separated list of integers on one line, print the sum of all elements.

title: Reverse a String
description: Given a single word, print it reversed.

title: Find Maximum in Array
description: Given a space-separated list of integers, print the largest one.

title: Check Even or Odd
description: Given a single integer, print "Even" if it is even, otherwise print "Odd".

title: Two Sum
description: Given a space-separated array on the first line and a target integer on the second line, print the two indices (0-based, space-separated) whose values add up to the target.

title: Count Vowels
description: Given a single lowercase word, print the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) it contains.

title: Check Palindrome
description: Given a single lowercase word, print "true" if it reads the same forwards and backwards, otherwise print "false".

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence (Length)
description: Given a space-separated list of integers, print the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Given space-separated intervals in the form "start,end" on one line, merge all overlapping intervals and print the result in the same "start,end" format, space-separated, sorted by start.

title: Longest Common Subsequence (Length)
description: Given two words on two separate lines, print the length of their longest common subsequence.

title: Count Positive Numbers
description: Given a space-separated list of integers, print the number of positive integers.

title: Find Minimum in Array
description: Given a space-separated list of integers, print the smallest element.

title: Calculate Factorial
description: Given a non-negative integer, print its factorial.

title: Check Prime Number
description: Given an integer, print "Prime" if it is a prime number, otherwise print "Not Prime".

title: Count Digits
description: Given a positive integer, print the number of digits it contains.

title: Reverse a Number
description: Given an integer, print its digits in reverse order.

title: Sum of Digits
description: Given a positive integer, print the sum of all its digits.

title: Fibonacci Number
description: Given a non-negative integer n, print the nth Fibonacci number where F(0) = 0 and F(1) = 1.

title: Remove Spaces
description: Given a string, print the same string with all spaces removed.

title: Count Occurrences
description: Given an array of integers and a target integer on the second line, print how many times the target appears.

title: Second Largest Element
description: Given an array of distinct integers, print the second largest element.

title: Remove Duplicates
description: Given a sorted array of integers, print the elements without duplicates in their original order.

title: Move Zeros to End
description: Given an array of integers, move all zeros to the end while maintaining the relative order of non-zero elements.

title: Rotate Array Right
description: Given an array and an integer k on the second line, rotate the array to the right by k positions.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array on the first line and a target integer on the second line, print the 0-based index of the target, or -1 if it is not present.

title: Intersection of Two Arrays
description: Given two arrays on separate lines, print the unique elements that appear in both arrays in ascending order.

title: Majority Element
description: Given an array where one element appears more than half the time, print that majority element.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Given daily stock prices, print the maximum profit possible from buying once and selling once later.

title: Valid Anagram
description: Given two lowercase words on separate lines, print "true" if they contain the same characters with the same frequencies, otherwise print "false".

title: First Non-Repeating Character
description: Given a lowercase string, print the first character that appears exactly once, or -1 if every character repeats.

title: Longest Word
description: Given a space-separated sentence, print the longest word. If multiple words have the same length, print the first one.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Given a string containing only parentheses characters (), {}, and [], print "true" if every opening bracket is correctly closed and nested, otherwise print "false".

title: Evaluate Postfix Expression
description: Given a space-separated postfix expression containing integers and the operators +, -, *, and /, print the evaluated result. Division should truncate toward zero.

title: Queue Using Array
description: Given a sequence of queue operations where ENQUEUE x adds x and DEQUEUE removes the front element, print all values removed by DEQUEUE operations.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
description: Given an array of integers, print the maximum possible sum of a contiguous subarray.

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an array of integers, print an array where each position contains the product of every element except the element at that position.

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Given an array of integers and a target k on the second line, print the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals k.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Given an unsorted array of integers, print the length of the longest sequence of consecutive integers.

title: Three Sum
description: Given an array of integers, print the number of unique triplets whose values add up to zero.

title: Container With Most Water
description: Given an array representing vertical line heights, print the maximum amount of water that can be contained between two lines.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given an array of non-negative heights, print the total amount of rainwater that can be trapped between the bars.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string, print the length of the longest substring containing no repeated characters.

title: Group Anagrams
description: Given space-separated lowercase words, print the number of groups of words that are anagrams of each other.

title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
description: Given a positive integer target on the first line and an array of positive integers on the second line, print the minimum length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least the target. Print 0 if none exists.

title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted arrays on separate lines, merge them into one sorted array and print the result.

title: Find Missing Number
description: Given n distinct integers from the range 0 to n, print the missing number.

title: Find Duplicate Number
description: Given an array containing n+1 integers where every integer is between 1 and n, with exactly one value repeated, print the repeated value.

title: Climbing Stairs
description: Given n stairs, print the number of distinct ways to reach the top when you can climb either 1 or 2 stairs at a time.

title: House Robber
description: Given an array representing money in houses, print the maximum amount that can be stolen without robbing two adjacent houses.

title: Coin Change
description: Given coin denominations on the first line and an amount on the second line, print the minimum number of coins needed to make the amount. Print -1 if the amount cannot be formed.

title: Number of Islands
description: Given a grid represented by rows of 0s and 1s separated by spaces, print the number of connected groups of 1s. Cells are connected horizontally and vertically.
